mentions.name: ONLY EV AI Sales Agent
mentions.description: An AI sales agent focused on electric cars. Users ask the agent about their electric car needs, and it matches them to vehicles using an inventory feed from a partner dealer, currently running as a pilot. A demo video is available and the team aims to ship soon.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on an [ONLY EV AI SALES AGENT]. I have a dealer feed. I am focused on Electric cars. Basically you ask the AI agent about your electric car needs and using our inventory feed from our dealer partner ( pilot) we match user to car.
